correctness.rationale: On the unsubdivided K4,4 the two-particle Abrams cubical model has 28 unordered vertex-pair cells, 96 vertex/edge cells and 72 disjoint-edge two-cells. Independently reconstructed the signed integer boundary matrices: ranks 27 and 60, ∂1∂2=0, SNF(∂2) has 59 factors 1 and one factor 2; connectedness/primitivity gives H1=Z^9⊕Z/2, H2=Z^12. Constructed all eighteen complementary K2,2 product-torus cycles independently and checked ∂2T=0 and SNF(T) has twelve unit factors, so the torus lattice saturates ker∂2, rather than merely spanning rationally. Independently recomputed all 1152 automorphism traces of H2 on the twelve-dimensional lattice: on (σ,τ) they equal χ22(σ)χ211(τ)+χ211(σ)χ22(τ), and vanish on the exchanging coset, identifying the induced Specht representation. H1 rational tensor augmentation and negative factor-flip follow from ordered maturity/graph cycle module and edge-orientation flip; neither positive-degree representation has W invariants. All statements are finite exact for K4,4, not general Kp,q.
